decisions.reason: The garage door operator line builds directly on the firm's core door and drive know-how, so the firm can interpret its market feedback and keep refining the models, even though 2020-2021 visibility was not observed.
The glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's industrial door competence, but its overlap with E and F and its low web visibility raise the risk of the range being consolidated.
The insulated glazed version draws on the firm's thermal expertise and meets rising energy-efficiency requirements, so own development can keep improving it.
With a dedicated page and a close fit to the firm's manufacturing and materials knowledge, this door remains a well-understood part of the industrial range.
